purpose: Audit image independence of existing demo4 cross-class-fold development experiments
sampling: Exact numpy seed=0 episode generator in icx/common.py, one support per query; no model inference or query labels read
overlap_definition: A test query or support image also appears in either role in any of the three training folds
interpretation: Class-disjoint validation is confirmed to share photos. This does not quantify inflation or invalidate all gains; it prevents a strict image-independent generalization claim. Existing cohorts remain development evidence. New experiments should group all support/query image IDs across training, validation and test.
